Calculate Overall Quality Score from Summaries

Source: R/1a_checks_overall_score.R
calculate_overall_score1.Rd

Builds the same score table as calculate_overall_score(), but from summaries that have already been calculated.

Usage

calculate_overall_score1(
  average_reporting_rate,
  district_reporting_rate,
  district_completeness,
  outliers_summary,
  district_outliers_summary,
  ratios_summary,
  labels = NULL,
  threshold = .cd_method$data_quality$reporting_threshold
)

Arguments

average_reporting_rate

A cd_average_reporting_rate object with a mean_rr column by year.

district_reporting_rate

A cd_district_reporting_rate object.

district_completeness

A cd_missing_district object, as returned by calculate_district_completeness_summary().

outliers_summary

A cd_outlier object with a mean_out_all column by year.

district_outliers_summary

A cd_district_outliers_summary object.

ratios_summary

A cd_ratios_and_adequacy object.

labels

Optional named list overriding the default row labels, with header, section and metric sub-lists (see calculate_overall_score()). Default is NULL.

threshold

Numeric. The district reporting rate threshold shown in the label of row 1b. Default is 90.

Value

A tibble with calculated scores for each metric, including a summary row for the annual quality score.
